subject.name: AP World History: Modern
subject.cedVersion: AP World History: Modern CED (Course Framework V.1, (c)2026; effective Fall 2026)
subject.designNotes: 9 units (c. 1200 to the present) with official CED topic codes (71 topics: U1 7, U2 7, U3 4, U4 8, U5 10, U6 8, U7 9, U8 9, U9 9), titles, class-period estimates, and suggested skills from the Unit at a Glance tables. MC unit weights come from the CED exam weighting (U1 8-10, U2 8-10, U3-U6 12-15, U7-U9 8-10 percent). Skills are the historical thinking skills 1.A-6.D; Skill 6 (argumentation) is not assessed in the multiple-choice section, and skill/reasoning-process weights are not published. Sub-keywords, kinds, requires and estLessons are original tutoring-sequence proposals in neutral, mainstream wording.
